text: きみも　ポケモン　やってるか！

structure.jp: ポケモン　やってるか！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is ongoing, and in speech it shrinks to てる. やってる = 'are doing', here 'are into'.

patterns.name: 〜か
patterns.explanation: か said with a falling voice is not a real question; the speaker has just noticed something. やってるか！ = 'so you do it too, huh!'
